Subject: Intro request - Zephyr Retail (Marketplace + co-sell)

Hi Olivia / AWS Marketplace team,

Quick ask: Zephyr Retail (procurement contact copied below) is evaluating hosted LLM inference for search and personalization. They asked if we can engage via the AWS marketplace co-sell path so procurement and security get the right artifacts, and so AWS can co-own the customer intro.

Can you lead the intro to Zephyr and include an AE/SE so we can run a joint account plan (JAP) and align on procurement timelines? I'll share a draft JAP and our product one-pager in follow-up. Suggested objectives for the first 30-minute intro:
- Align stakeholders (procurement, platform, security)
- High-level scope of pilot (query volumes, data residency constraints)
- Marketplace contracting path + expected timeline

Proposed times (PT): Tue 11/23 10:00-10:30, Wed 11/24 09:00-09:30, or Thu 11/25 11:00-11:30. If AWS can pick an AE/SE and confirm, I'll send an official calendar invite and JAP draft.

Zephyr contact: Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@zephyrretail.com> (Head of Platform)

Thanks — Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182
